## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Cadaqués, Spain. It starts at Platja Portlligat.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Like the artist's work, the structure of Dalí's home has more than a hint of surrealism. With no window the same shape, blind passageways, and a lamp you won't find anywhere else, the Dalí House takes you directly into the mind of the artist.
>
> Looking out over the Portlligat bay, the tour showcases the wonderful elements of the house, and gives a glimpse into the life Dalí and his wife Gala shared there. Visitors will also be able to see the studio where his timeless works were created.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €21.72. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 780 ratings and 360 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
